topic.bc01-the-book.speaker: hulm-tei
topic.bc01-the-book.prompt: Tell me about the estate's debt book.
lines: Every line of the estate's debt book is true. Rows-For-Another's food is in it. So is the boat's upkeep, and her sick days. An Owing is a debt paid in work. I name a buy-out by the book. I am a steward. I am not a slaver.

topic.bc01-the-estate.speaker: never-sold
lines: Rows-For-Another took a boat from the estate north of Blackrose. She took it on an Owing of four months. An Owing is a debt paid in work. That was eleven years ago. She works it still. I have saved enough to buy out the Owing. Hulm-Tei, the steward, keeps the debt book in a locked chest on the landing. Take the swamp road north out of Blackrose. The landing is a short walk on, on the channel side, with boats at the water. I will meet you there.

topic.bc01-bring-down.speaker: never-sold
topic.bc01-bring-down.prompt: I have the estate's debt book.
lines: That is the book. I will read her page. Every line is true: her food, the boat's upkeep, her sick days. I do not argue it. I tear out her page and give it to her. Then I leave four months in coin in the steward's chest. That was the first price.

topic.bc01-cut-loose.speaker: rows-for-another
lines: I will not wait on the book. Two estate men walk the landing at night. Past them, the channel runs out of the estate's reach. I cannot drown in it. Go first. I will follow you.
day: Not in daylight, with the men watching. Come back after dark. Then I will go with you.
